data.title: coParenter - coParenting App
data.description:
We know co-parenting can be hard. The coParenter app helps you manage and support your children through better
communication and organization with your coParent. We can save you time and money, all while keeping you out of
court.
App features include:
Parenting Plans & Calendars
- Create customized and clear parenting plans with your coParent by answering a few simple questions.
- Keep schedules organized with shared, color-coded calendars and clear responsibilities.
- Schedule and track same-day visits.
coParenting Requests
- Agree on day-to-day coParenting decisions like haircuts, hygiene, diet, media, allowance, etc.
- Request new calendar items such as parenting time and extracurricular activities.
- Manage modifications to your parenting plans and calendars.
Unlimited On-Demand coParenting Mediation and One-on-One Counseling
- Connect with a live, qualified, coParenter Mediator who can help you and your coParent reach agreements.
- Get one-on-one counseling to help you navigate and make better decisions for you and your children.
coParenting Messenger
- Instant, direct, and organized in-app messaging.
- Messages can’t be edited or deleted, giving you a history of communication.
- Focus on child-centric, positive coParenting with AI filters to help you avoid conflict language (don’t send or
receive hostile messages).
Expense Tracking and Agreements
- Establish a record of your agreements to help you both focus on your kids.
- Align / agree on spending decisions with your coParent.
- Track and request expense reimbursements.
Child Exchange Check-Ins
- Keep a clear, secure record of your exchanges, pick-ups and drop-offs through in-app geo-tagging and time
stamping.
- Receive notifications and easily access records.
Let us help you put your kids in the center, not the middle. Download the app with a 30-day trial today. After your trial expires you can pick one of four auto-renewing subscription options coParenter offers.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
CoParenter offers four auto-renewing subscription options:
Monthly Plan - $12.99 per month. (Billed monthly)
Annual Plan - $9.99* per month. (*Billed as one $119.99 payment annually)
Shared Monthly Plan - $19.99 per month for two users. (Billed Monthly)
Shared Annual Plan - $16.67** per month for two users. (**Billed as one $199.99 payment annually)
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your coParenter subscription will automatically renew and your account will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Apple ID settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew.
